description: Returns app installations for the company identified by company_id or project_id.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the company. You must supply either a company_id or project_id.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project. You must supply either a company_id or project_id.

id.description: Unique identifier for this app installation.

app_uid.description: UID of the OAuth application for this installation.

agentic.description: True when the installed app version's manifest declares agentic components (MCP servers or agents)

components.description: Component types associated with the installation

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns this installation.

installed_at.description: Date the app was installed or reinstalled

id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

login.description: The email address of the user that is used to log in.

is_active.description: User's contact is active in company

app_version_id.description: ID of the installed app version.

updatable_app_version_id.description: ID of the app version that can be updated to
